response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux, COUNT(*) AS qc_count FROM scanqc q JOIN projects p ON q.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux) SELECT fundflux, qc_count, CAST(qc_count AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(qc_count) FROM c) AS fraction_of_total, CAST(qc_count AS REAL) / (SELECT AVG(qc_count) FROM c) AS ratio_to_average FROM c
